text: My daily routine is quite simple, and I try to follow it every day. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a healthy breakfast. After that, I get ready and begin work at nine. I work until five, but I always take a short break at lunchtime. In the afternoon, I go to the gym or go running for about an hour. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch a series, and read a book before bed. I believe consistency is the key to a balanced and happy life.
